import sys
import math
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(int, data[:3])
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    x //= g
    y //= g
    q = x // y
    rem = x % y

    heap = []

    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        gb = math.gcd(y, b)
        c = b // gb
        z = y // gb
        t = b * z
        u = q * t + rem * c

        # floor candidate
        a = u // z
        gg = math.gcd(a, b)
        dist = float(abs(u - a * z)) / t
        heapq.heappush(heap, (dist, b // gg, a // gg))

        # ceil candidate if not exact
        if u % z != 0:
            a = (u + z - 1) // z
            gg = math.gcd(a, b)
            dist = float(abs(u - a * z)) / t
            heapq.heappush(heap, (dist, b // gg, a // gg))

    # best candidate is the smallest (dist, den, num)
    _, den, num = heapq.heappop(heap)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{num}/{den}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
